selected.rationale: Loss on the compose-post->unique-id edge hangs the first mandatory dependency of the write path if no timeout exists, exposing unbounded latency to the client. Unique-id is the post identifier source; the whole composition cannot proceed without it.
A dropped call to post-storage during compose-post makes the primary persistence unavailable; with no retry/timeout the request fails or hangs. This reveals missing defense on the core storage edge.
Home-timeline reads depend on post-storage; loss on this edge removes all feed content or hangs the read path. It exposes lack of timeout/fallback/caching in the read pipeline.

Killing social-graph removes the follower data needed by home-timeline, causing feed availability loss. This reveals the read path has no fallback or automatic recovery when an upstream dependency dies.

Loss on the compose-post->home-timeline edge tests whether a timeline-push side-effect is synchronously coupled to post creation and lacks a timeout. If the call is waited on, one dropped packet stalls the entire write; if not, the feed is silently inconsistent.

The user-timeline write is a synchronous part of compose-post; a loss here exposes missing timeout/retry on timeline updates. Failure to complete this edge either hangs the request or loses the user's own timeline entry.

User validation/context is required before composing a post; loss on this edge hangs/fails the write path. It verifies whether the system has any timeout or degradation for a core user-service dependency.
Text processing is part of the post content pipeline; a dropped call on this edge fails or hangs post creation. It exposes lack of retry/timeout for an auxiliary but required processing service.
